tooltip.essentialcraft5.attraction_modul.en: Pushes nearby drops and experience orbs to your feet. Items someone threw stay put, and sneaking stops it
tooltip.essentialcraft5.attraction_modul.zh: 把身边的掉落物和经验球推到你脚边，有人扔出来的不推，潜行时停下

tooltip.essentialcraft5.stride_module.en: Raises your step height, so you walk straight up taller ledges
tooltip.essentialcraft5.stride_module.zh: 抬高步子，更高的坎也能直接走上去

tooltip.essentialcraft5.steady_hand_modu.en: Mining no longer slows down while you're off the ground or have your head underwater
tooltip.essentialcraft5.steady_hand_modu.zh: 悬在空中、头在水里时挖东西不再变慢

tooltip.essentialcraft5.veil_module.en: Mobs have to come closer before they notice you, closer still while you sneak; players aren't affected
tooltip.essentialcraft5.veil_module.zh: 怪物要走得更近才会发现你，潜行时还要更近，对玩家不起作用
